_meta.description: Astrological Identity Layer — core of the person, rarely changes

motivation_core.description: Driven by building something lasting. Not urgency — precision and depth. Needs to be the expert in the room, not the loudest.

energy_style.pattern: high capacity, slow recovery, thrives under sustained pressure
energy_style.description: Can carry enormous load for long periods. But recovery is private and non-negotiable. Social energy drains fast — needs solitude to recharge.
manifestation: collapses if recovery time is cut

emotional_regulation.pattern: delayed processing, routes emotion through analysis
emotional_regulation.description: Does not experience emotions in real time. Processes days or weeks later, often through thinking or work. Appears composed under pressure — not because calm, but because processing is deferred.
manifestation: high internal pressure with calm exterior
difficulty naming feelings in the moment

ambition_structure.description: Thinks in years, not quarters. Career moves look sudden from outside but are long-incubated internally. Each major transition is a complete identity rebuild, not an adjustment.
manifestation: needs to see the 5-year picture before acting

decision_style.description: Extended analysis phase followed by decisive, often irreversible action. Looks indecisive until suddenly it is not. Mercury retrograde natal reinforces loop tendency.
manifestation: once decision made — executes fast and completely
revisits decisions during Mercury retrograde transits

relationship_model.pattern: needs full autonomy within committed structures
relationship_model.description: Deep loyalty but strong resistance to emotional dependency. Partnership must be functional and growth-oriented, not comfort-based. Takes long time to trust.
